obligations.source_text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

bindings.marker_phrase: the adult presents one specific work achievement or role marker through the unveiled mechanical heron and its maker plaque
bindings.presentation_phrase: the presentation action occurs before an identifiable audience gathered around the mobile festival stage
bindings.audience_phrase: several audience members respond independently toward presenter and marker by turning phones, lifting star paddles, and applauding
bindings.result_phrase: attention access award or introduction changes immediately as the public tally lights and the front aisle opens toward her
bindings.causal_phrase: presenter marker and audience responses form one causal arc from her self-pointing unveiling gesture to their directed applause
